title: sf-patch-day mods file
description: What a mod relies on in the master plugins it builds on, for sf-patch-day drift.

mod.description: Your mod's name, shown in the report.

masters.description: One entry per master plugin file name (Starfield.esm, a DLC, a Creation or another mod).

used_by.description: Your mods or parts that rely on this master.

ba2.description: The archive holding the master's scripts (needed for functions).

type.description: Record type, such as QUST. When every record has one, scanning is much faster.

copied.description: true when your plugin ships a copy (override) of this record: any change means rebuild.

stages.description: Quest stages your scripts set: a missing one means rebuild.

functions.description: Script path inside the archive -> function names your scripts call by name.
